issue.body:
### Description

Trying to print (or generally calling `__repr__` on) a new style PRNG key that has been put on the cpu results in an XlaRuntimeError. 
```python
import jax

key = jax.random.key(0)
old_key = jax.random.PRNGKey(0)
cpu = jax.devices("cpu")[0]
print(old_key)
print(key)
print()
print(jax.device_put(old_key, cpu))
print(jax.device_put(key, cpu))
```
results in 
```
[0 0]
Array((), dtype=key<fry>) overlaying:
[0 0]

      8 print()
      9 print(jax.device_put(old_key, cpu))
---> 10 print(jax.device_put(key, cpu))

3 frames

[/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/jax/_src/array.py](https://localhost:8080/#) in _value(self)
    611     if self._npy_value is None:
    612       if self.is_fully_replicated:
--> 613         self._npy_value = self._single_device_array_to_np_array()
    614         self._npy_value.flags.writeable = False
    615         return cast(np.ndarray, self._npy_value)
```
